works.body:
Nice to meet you! Hello!

I love the atmosphere of ᴰᴺᴬ's illustrations so much that I contacted you to request an illustration.

This time, I would like to request an illustration of a purple-haired vampire girl.

Her character is a little tsundere and has a devilish atmosphere. There are several patterns for her costume, but we would be happy if you could freely choose your favorite design and draw it.
If possible, you are also welcome to design a new costume in your own taste!

We would appreciate it if you could leave only the hair style and the bat bow on the head as it is.

We would also be happy to leave the pose, composition, and facial expressions entirely up to you.
Since the character is a vampire, we would be very happy if you could draw pointed ears, fangs, etc!

Thank you in advance for your cooperation!


 Character profile↓↓↓

🔹 Purple-haired girl (Kidera)
 - Age: A vampire girl who looks about 15 years old
 - Eye color: Blue
 - Personality: Tsundere

 🔸 Usage
The illustration will be used as an icon and X header.

We have attached the character's materials below, so please check them out.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1OjcFKfwl6ZWCrdRQzqUsENoXuQ_N8NHF

Thank you very much for your time and consideration!
